feed.title: Chapter 1: AI vs Machine Learning — Civil Engineer's Guide to AI
feed.subtitle: Updates to Chapter 1 sub-lessons.

entry.title: 1.1 What is Artificial Intelligence?
entry.summary: Explore the foundations of Artificial Intelligence through the lens of civil engineering. Learn what AI is, how it works, and why it matters for modern infrastructure.

entry.title: 1.2 History of AI - Timeline & Milestones
entry.summary: Explore the complete history of Artificial Intelligence from Aristotle to GPT-4, with civil engineering analogies and interactive timelines.

entry.title: 1.3 AI Capabilities — Perception, Reasoning, Learning, Interaction
entry.summary: Explore AI's four core capabilities - Perception, Reasoning, Learning, and Interaction - through civil engineering analogies, interactive demos, and real-world applications.

entry.title: 1.4 Subfields of AI — Computer Vision, NLP, Robotics & More
entry.summary: Explore the major subfields of Artificial Intelligence - Computer Vision, NLP, Robotics, Expert Systems, Planning, Speech Recognition, and ML - with civil engineering applications, interactive demos, and quizzes.

entry.title: 1.5 Types of AI — ANI, AGI, ASI & Memory Classification
entry.summary: Learn how Artificial Intelligence is classified by capability (ANI, AGI, ASI) and by memory (Reactive, Limited Memory, Theory of Mind, Self-Aware). Interactive demos, civil engineering analogies, and quizzes.

entry.title: 1.6 What is Machine Learning? — Core Concepts
entry.summary: Understand Machine Learning from the ground up: the shift from programming rules to learning from data. Interactive demos, civil engineering analogies, and quizzes for engineers.

entry.title: 1.7 The ML Pipeline — Data to Deployment
entry.summary: Walk through the complete Machine Learning pipeline from problem definition to deployment. Interactive demos, civil engineering analogies, and quizzes for engineers.

entry.title: 1.8 AI vs ML — The Critical Distinction
entry.summary: Understand the crucial difference between Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Interactive Venn diagrams, classification games, and decision guides for civil engineers.

entry.title: 1.9 The Dam vs River Analogy — Central Metaphor
entry.summary: The central metaphor: AI is the Dam (engineered system), ML is the River (data flow). Interactive dam simulation, component explorer, and deep analogy mapping for civil engineers.

entry.title: 1.10 Types of Machine Learning — Supervised, Unsupervised, RL, Semi-supervised
entry.summary: Explore the four main types of machine learning — supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and semi-supervised learning — with civil engineering analogies, interactive demos, and quizzes.

entry.title: 1.11 Introduction to Deep Learning — Neural Networks
entry.summary: Explore the fundamentals of deep learning and neural networks through a civil engineering lens. Learn about neurons, layers, backpropagation, and why depth matters — with interactive demos and quizzes.

entry.title: 1.12 Bias, Ethics & CE Applications
entry.summary: Explore bias in AI/ML systems, ethical considerations for civil engineering, and a comprehensive overview of real-world AI applications in structural health monitoring, crack detection, traffic optimization, and more.
